title: TBD Map Locations
description: Named settlements, peaks, and cartographic labels for a terrain. Coordinates are x east, y north, in world metres — the same frame as the terrain manifest's `worldBounds`.

name.description: Human display label for cartographic text. The exporter rejects the engine placeholder 'Location composition'.

y.description: North meters (Reforger world Z → export Y).

importance.description: A3-style label importance for declutter (0 = minor, 1 = capital).

kind.description: Optional taxonomy for rendering and filtering; omitted means `town`. The town label lane draws town, village and airport at every zoom, plus locality at deck zoom ≥ 0.
